card.name: Numbers just before a multiplication sign
card.fires_on: Digits (or a variable like Ca) that begin a number or term which is followed by a unit, a times sign, or a product, such as 20 mg, 1.0 x 10 9, or Ca x P.

modes.label: Value before x or dot

modes.label: Product terms
modes.description: Variable or number in a product expression such as Ca x P or 4 ⋅ 5n-1.
